address: Av. Amilcar Barca, 14, Chiclana de la Frontera, 11139, Spain
bio: This restaurant, located in the Iberostar Selection Andalucía Playa hotel and equipped with a pleasant terrace (sometimes with live music), has fish from the fish market as its cornerstone, grilled fish (large pieces by weight) as its standard, and as a great influence... the iconic Elkano restaurant in Getaria! The menu, not lacking in Basque influences, is complemented by a tasting menu (36º6º) that invites us on a stroll along the seabed of the coast of Cádiz....
